parameter: EIA 2.2 Water: temperature excess at most 3 K at 100 m from the diffuser
remarks: ALP-EPC-00000-PR-STU-0003 (CW thermal plume and outfall dispersion study); ALP-EPC-00UPA-CV-CVL-0001 (marine structures); guarantee PG-14 test procedure. Status preliminary until the plume study is issued.
value_text: The outfall diffuser is designed to keep the thermal plume excess at the edge of the mixing zone within DP-CASE-0016; this is performance guarantee PG-14 (must-rectify remedy, no tolerance) and is verified by the thermal plume survey of the EIA monitoring plan, summer conditions, base load. The seawater temperature basis is DP-OWNR-0012.
